## SurveyJS

Installed in this project: `survey-pdf@3.0.1`. UI framework: **vanilla**.

The SurveyJS agent skills are installed in `.agents/skills`. Read the skill that matches the task before writing or changing SurveyJS code — they carry the current v3 API and the mistakes to check generated code against:

- [`surveyjs-form-json`](.agents/skills/surveyjs-form-json/SKILL.md) — Author, edit, or debug SurveyJS survey/form JSON
- [`surveyjs-pdf-generator`](.agents/skills/surveyjs-pdf-generator/SKILL.md) — Generate PDF documents from SurveyJS forms with SurveyJS PDF Generator (the survey-pdf package)

Everything between the `surveyjs:start` and `surveyjs:end` markers is regenerated by `surveyjs-cli 0.1.1` (`npx surveyjs-cli@latest init-agents`). Put your own notes outside the markers.
